title: The condensed ring $\underline{\mathcal O}_E$
statement:
Let $E$ be a field with an embedding $E\hookrightarrow\Qlb$, topologized as in
[def-sfb-padic-subfield-condensed-ring]. Let $\cO_E=\{x\in E:|x|_E\le1\}$ be its ring of
integers, the valuation subring of the restricted absolute value, with the subspace
topology. The condensed ring $\underline{\cO}_E$ is the condensed ring of
[def-sfb-continuous-map-condensed-ring] for $\cO_E$:

$$
\underline{\cO}_E(S)=C(S,\cO_E).
$$

Its underlying ring object is commutative. Postcomposition with continuous inclusions
([def-sfb-continuous-map-condensed-ring-map]) gives the morphism of condensed rings
$\underline{\cO}_E\to\underline E$ ([def-sfb-padic-subfield-condensed-ring]). When $E$ is
an extension of $\mathbf Q_\ell$ with $\mathbf Q_\ell$-linear embedding, it also gives
$\underline{\mathbf Z}_\ell\to\underline{\cO}_E$ ([def-sfb-padic-int-condensed-ring]).

proof.text: Let $|\cdot|$ on $\Qlb$ and $|x|_E=|\iota(x)|$ be as in [def-sfb-padic-subfield-condensed-ring]. For each $n\in\mathbf N$, extension of the $\ell$-adic absolute value gives $|(n:\Qlb)|=|(n:\mathbf Q_\ell)|_\ell\leq1$: for $n\ne0$ its $\ell$-adic valuation is nonnegative by the rational valuation formula of [def-weil-l-adic-numbers], and $|0|=0$. Apply [lem-sfb-ultrametric-criterion-natural-norms] to $\Qlb$ equipped with this norm. Its ultrametric distance inequality, evaluated at $0,a,a+b$, gives $|a+b|\leq\max(|a|,|b|)$. Restricting along the ring embedding gives $|x+y|_E\leq\max(|x|_E,|y|_E)$ on $E$. This does not require $E$ to contain $\mathbf Q_\ell$.

The set $\cO_E=\{x:|x|_E\leq1\}$ contains $0$ and $1$. For $x,y\in\cO_E$, the preceding inequality gives $|x+y|_E\leq1$, while $|-x|_E=|x|_E\leq1$ and $|xy|_E=|x|_E|y|_E\leq1$. It is therefore a commutative subring. If $x\ne0$ lies outside it, then $|x^{-1}|_E=|x|_E^{-1}<1$, so it is a valuation subring. Its subspace topology makes addition, negation and multiplication continuous: each is the restriction of the corresponding continuous operation on the topological field of [def-sfb-padic-subfield-condensed-ring], with image in the subring. Explicitly, if $m:E\times E\to E$ is addition or multiplication and $r:\cO_E\times\cO_E\to\cO_E$ its restriction, then for an ambient open $U\subseteq E$, $r^{-1}(U\cap\cO_E)=(\cO_E\times\cO_E)\cap m^{-1}(U)$, which is open in the product subspace topology; for ambient negation $N(x)=-x$ and its restriction $n:\cO_E\to\cO_E$, $n^{-1}(U\cap\cO_E)=\cO_E\cap N^{-1}(U)$ is open in $\cO_E$. Thus $\cO_E$ is a commutative topological ring.

Apply [def-sfb-continuous-map-condensed-ring] to this commutative topological ring $\cO_E$. It gives the sheaf of rings with sections $C(S,\cO_E)$, restriction by precomposition and pointwise operations, and a commutative underlying ring object. This is the stated $\underline{\cO}_E$.

The subring inclusion $j:\cO_E\hookrightarrow E$ is a unital ring homomorphism. It is continuous since $j^{-1}(U)=U\cap\cO_E$ for every open $U\subseteq E$. Applying [def-sfb-continuous-map-condensed-ring-map] gives $j_*:\underline{\cO}_E\to\underline E$, where [def-sfb-padic-subfield-condensed-ring] identifies the target sections with $C(S,E)$; its component is $f\mapsto j\circ f$.

For the final clause let $\alpha:\mathbf Q_\ell\to E$ be the extension structure map and suppose $\iota$ is $\mathbf Q_\ell$-linear. For $a\in\mathbf Q_\ell$, write $\alpha(a)=a\cdot1_E$. Linearity and $\iota(1_E)=1_{\Qlb}$ give $\iota(\alpha(a))=\iota(a\cdot1_E)=a\cdot\iota(1_E)=a$ in $\Qlb$. From the absolute value formula and extension hypothesis in the statement of [def-sfb-padic-subfield-condensed-ring], $|\alpha(a)|_E=|a|_\ell$, hence $|\alpha(a)-\alpha(b)|_E=|a-b|_\ell$. Thus $\alpha$ is isometric and continuous. The description $\mathbf Z_\ell=\{a:|a|_\ell\leq1\}$ in [def-weil-l-adic-numbers] shows its restriction takes values in $\cO_E$. The map $h:\mathbf Z_\ell\to\cO_E$ is a ring homomorphism. For every subspace open $U\cap\cO_E$, $h^{-1}(U\cap\cO_E)=\mathbf Z_\ell\cap\alpha^{-1}(U)$ is open in $\mathbf Z_\ell$ for its induced $\ell$-adic topology, so $h$ is continuous.

The condensed ring of the source of $h$ is $\underline{\mathbf Z}_\ell$ by [def-sfb-padic-int-condensed-ring]. Apply [def-sfb-continuous-map-condensed-ring-map] to the continuous ring homomorphism $h$ from the preceding step. This gives $\underline{\mathbf Z}_\ell\to\underline{\cO}_E$ with components $f\mapsto h\circ f$, exactly the required postcomposition map.
